sourceWindow.note: GitHub returned its rolling daily traffic window. The partial capture day was not included in the returned series.

repositoryViews.meaning: Repository-page views only. They are not website visits, players, plays, enjoyment, retention or growth.

repositoryClones.reason: Clone totals can include development work, continuous integration and other automated retrieval. They are excluded from audience and play claims.

interpretation.finding: The public repository is a useful proof and search shelf, but this window does not show meaningful audience attention arriving through GitHub.
interpretation.decision: Do not spend the next growth cycle polishing an already-complete GitHub listing. Keep it accurate and move the next test to a place where adults are already looking for browser games.
interpretation.nextMove: One direct-link r/WebGames post remains the highest-impact prepared test. It still needs Kevin's adult account confirmation, exact action-time approval and personal reply coverage.

truthRules: A repository view is not a player or a play.
A clone is not a person, a player or evidence of interest.
A popular path count does not prove that somebody started the game.
An empty referrer list does not prove that no outside link exists.
This fourteen-day snapshot does not prove growth or the absence of future discovery.
